text:
B: Hiya, mate! Alright? Can you hear me?
A: Yeah, fine. Gareth.
B: Rhys. Nice one. How you finding it so far? I've had two now, it's sort of like speed dating but no one's fancying anyone, do you know what I mean.
A: Ha. Something like that.
B: Where you to, then?
A: Sorry, say that again?
B: Sorry, where you from, like? It's a Welsh thing, that.
A: Solihull. Shirley.
B: Oh right. Lots of Midlands lot in this, isn't there. What do you do? You look proper professional, I'm not gonna lie.
A: Quantity surveyor. Commercial manager at a contractor in Birmingham. Hospitals, schools.
B: Quantity surveyor. So what's that, like, you count stuff?
A: More or less. I look after the money on a build. What it should cost, what we pay the subcontractors, what we get paid by the client. Making sure the numbers come out right at the end, basically.
B: Fair play. I'd be useless at that. I can't even keep track of my own money, I'm skint by the twentieth every month.
A: What do you do?
B: Supermarket, shelves. Early mornings. I was up half four today, so if I go quiet I've just fallen asleep, yeah?
A: Right.
B: I've been thinking about doing a plastering course, though. My mate's uncle's a plasterer, he's doing tidy out of it.
A: They do alright. Good plasterers are hard to get on site. We're always waiting on them.
B: Yeah? See, that's what I need to hear. How long's the course, do you know?
A: No idea, to be honest. Couple of months for the basics, probably. Then it's getting the hours in.
B: Getting the hours in, yeah. That's the bit. Do you do much outside work, then?
A: Golf, Saturday mornings. Bit of running.
B: Golf! Go on then, what's your handicap?
A: Fourteen.
B: Is that good? I've only done crazy golf in Tenby and I lost to my sister.
A: It's alright. Not great. Trying to break eighty-five most weeks.
B: Did you this week?
A: Eighty-seven.
B: Close, mate! Next week. I play five-a-side Wednesdays, we lost again, seven-two. We're shocking, honest. Half of us are hanging from the weekend.
A: Football fan?
B: Cardiff. You?
A: Blues.
B: Oh, we've had some games, us two. Rough few years for both, to be fair.
A: Yeah. Owners are a joke.
B: Ours an' all, mate. Ours an' all. Do you go away much? Holidays, like?
A: Once a year. All-inclusive usually. Turkey, Canaries. Somewhere with a golf course nearby.
B: Tidy. I've done Magaluf and Benidorm with the boys. Benidorm was unreal, honestly, there was this one night—
A: Go on.
B: Nah, actually, I'll save it, it's not a work-appropriate one, like.
A: Probably for the best.
B: Ha! Basically I lost a shoe and—
